text:
mara: Quick brief request  product marketing needs a single-page "Decision Capsule" for deploy modes (hosted / dedicated / private). Field-friendly PDF + concise landing snippet. Focus: when to pick, two benchmark callouts, and inbound routing rules for compliance signals.

jon: Love the capsule idea. Keep it ultra-scannable: 2-line value prop, a 3-column decision strip (who, tradeoffs, typical ARR), two mini-benchmarks (latency | cost), a tiny engineer note, CTA to webinar & contact.

lee: Benchmarks for copy only: p50 gen latency ~90ms (Dedicated, 512 ctx); p95 tail under load ~330ms (Hosted burst). Cost callouts: hosted baseline ~$0.20/1k tokens; optimized dedicated stack ~$0.04/1k tokens. Add "approx" footnote.

anya: Webinar hook suggestion: "Deploy modes that stop surprise bills and spikes"  25-min live demo + customer microcase. Landing snippet: one headline, 3 bullets, signup CTA. For the compliance variant, swap bullets to emphasize isolation, KMS, audit logs.

mara: Good. For inbound lead routing keep deterministic rules so security/compliance hits go to field immediately. Proposed rules (HubSpot/Intercom):

```
- if body contains: "FedRAMP" OR "SOC2" OR "HIPAA" OR "PCI" then add tag=security_high
- if body contains: "on-prem" OR "air-gapped" OR "VPC" OR "no-cloud" then add tag=private_interest
- if ARR_est >= 100000 OR company_size >= 1500 then set=enterprise_signal
- route_to=AE_queue if tag=security_high OR tag=private_interest OR enterprise_signal==true
- fallback=SDR_queue
- webhook: POST lead + transcript to /ops-solutions for security_high
```

jon: Nice. Also include a 2-line engineer checklist: sample prompt (chat 64 tokens), expected latency band, tuning knobs (batch size, KV cache, quant). Include a one-liner about rollback: automatic model-variant fallback + canary.

lee: Add a micro-FAQ: "SLA differences?" (Hosted: shared; Dedicated: contract; Private: customizable + network isolation) and "Pilot options?" (30-day Dedicated pilot available).

routing-bot: rules staged (id rs-2029-09-01-02). Smoke tests: 5/5 passed. Test payloads routed to AE_queue for security hits.

mara: Perfect. I'll assemble the PDF + two landing microvariants (general & compliance) and drop links here. Target publish: next Tue. Tagging eng-sales and solutions for a quick read once drafts are posted. :memo:
